description: This PHP script manages the creation and storage of custom views in the vtiger CRM system, including defining view parameters, columns, filters, and saving them into the database.

methods.name: insertCustomView
methods.description: Stores a new custom view in the vtiger_customview table and returns its ID.

methods.name: insertCvColumns
methods.description: Stores column definitions for a custom view in the vtiger_cvcolumnlist table.

methods.name: insertCvStdFilter
methods.description: Stores a standard filter for a custom view in the vtiger_cvstdfilter table.

methods.name: insertCvAdvFilter
methods.description: Stores advanced filters for a custom view in the vtiger_cvadvfilter table and grouping in vtiger_cvadvfilter_grouping.
